headings.description: Elegant, quiet luxury serif for headings (H1, H2, H3). Brings a premium, editorial feel without overwhelming the dashboard.

body.description: Clean, highly readable sans-serif for body text. Provides a modern structural contrast to the elegant serif headings.

monospace.description: Used sparingly for eyebrows and very small labels, tracked out (letter-spacing).

colors.description: GHOP palette: leafy green, warm gold, royal purple, and clean white as the default surface.

grids_and_layouts.general: Maintain full-width responsive grids. No disproportionate scaling. Screens must fully span the viewport gracefully on both cellphone and desktop.
grids_and_layouts.cards: Ensure cards have adequate internal padding and finely detailed borders. Quiet luxury relies on precise, fine 1px borders and warm white surfaces without heavy inner gradients.

motion.hover_states: Soft, 0.3s ease-out translations and subtle shadow enhancements. Avoid aggressive scaling.
motion.buttons: Fade background and text colors smoothly over 0.2s.

component_instructions.cards: Update styles to use pure white background, subtle border_light, and the subtle shadow. Apply serif font to panel and metric card headings.
component_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons should use accent_strong (#B0A392) or accent_primary (#D4C4A8) background with white or espresso text. Ghost buttons use border_strong and text_primary.
component_instructions.sidebar: Update sidebar to use surface_secondary (#FAFAF8) with a delicate border_light right border. Active nav items should use accent_soft background and accent_strong text.
component_instructions.topbar: Semi-solid white background (e.g. rgba(255,255,255,0.95)) with backdrop-blur. Do NOT use completely transparent background for any overlay. Add 1px border-bottom using border_light.
component_instructions.metrics: Pulse charts and progress bars should use the champagne/gold accent colors instead of heavy green.
component_instructions.avatars: Use warm, earthy tones (champagne, espresso, taupe) for initials instead of bright multi-colors.

data_guidelines.names: Preserve Congolese and South African sample names.
data_guidelines.pastor: Use Pastor Daniel Katshing and include Pastor Phiwe Katshing as a second leadership profile.
data_guidelines.content: Keep existing church flows, metrics, and pulse ring exactly as they are structurally.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the GHOP brand palette: green #26734D, gold #C59A2B, purple #7650A4, and white #FFFFFF.
Keep white as the default surface and retain responsive layouts and existing data-testid attributes.
Display both Pastor Daniel Katshing and Pastor Phiwe Katshing in church leadership profiles.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use the GHOP green, gold, purple, and white palette with readable contrast.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Preserve existing application routes and functionality while following GHOP branding and the requested church color palette.
